snippet.title: exA-Arcadia『赤い刀 EXA LABEL』| CRIMSON (AKAI KATANA) KATANA EXA LABEL for Arcades | Attract Video
snippet.description:
CRIMSON KATANA EXA LABEL for Arcades on exA-Arcadia
Available Now

Players: 1-2
Genre: Shooter
Monitor: Horizontal (Recommended), Vertical
Languages: English, Japanese

FEATURES

3 PLAYABLE SHIPS
Choose from 3 pilots and their katana companions

4 PLAY MODES
ORIGINAL MODE - an improved port of the original game fixing unintended performance issues and hit box issues & gameplay improvements supervised by super player Kossy
CLIMAX (ZETSU) MODE  - the director's cut of the original game now with the TLB added 
SLASH (SHIN) MODE - an arranged mode with an added stage and new game mechanics
EXA LABEL MODE - a brand new game mode focused on bullet canceling

Extreme Difficulty is also available in each play mode.

2 PLAYER SIMULTANEOUS PLAY
All game modes now support 2 players that was not possible in previous versions

1 FRAME INPUT LAG RESPONSE - twice as fast as the arcade version and 5 times faster than any home version
Maximum Performance! Play like you’re meant to. Never get hit again.

3 SOUNDTRACKS
ORIGINAL - the arcade original soundtrack byRyu Umemoto now upgraded to be in HD stereo
ARRANGED - the arranged soundtrack by Ryu Umemoto also in HD stereo
FM - initially composed by Ryu Umemoto and completed posthumously by Keishi Yonao for this release

FULLY VOICED
Every character and story sequence is fully voiced by renowned anime voice actors!

CAST
TSUBAKI SHINJO - SAYAKA KINOSHITA
SUMIRE ASAKA - MAYUKO TAKAHASHI
BOTAN SAIONJI - HANA TAKEDA
KIKYO SAIONJI - MASAHIRO YAMANAKA
SHION KOBAYAKAWA - KAORI YAGI
SUZURAN SANADA - ERIKA
HIRAGI - KENYU HORIUCHI
SHUMEIGIKU - MII MIKI
SHAKUNAGE - EIJI HANAWA
NAZUNA - MAMI KAMEOKA
AYAME & RAN - IKUMI SATO
BASHO - YASUHIRO MAMIYA
